title: CWP/4273/2025 of BALWINDER KUMAR AND ANR Vs UNION OF INDIA AND ORS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ.
text: Stieeeras IN THE PUNJAB AND HARYANA HIGH COURT AT CHANDIGARH 122 CWP-4273-2025 Date of Decision: 17.02.2025 BALWINDER KUMAR AND ANR ... Petitioner VERSUS UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS ... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ. KEKK Present: Mr. Navdeep Singh, Ms. Roopan Atwal and Ms. Srishti Sharma, Advocates for the petitioners. Mr. Gaurav Pathak, Advocate for the respondents. (Through video conference) ake ake ake ake VINOD S. BHARDWAJ, J. (ORAL) The instant writ petition had been filed for seeking issuance of directions to the respondents to continue the medical treatment of petitioner No.2, who is in a medically delicate shape and is a patient of “Chronic Kidney Disease with Kidney Transplant” to which he is entitled for life under the policies dated 30.12.2002 and 18.12.2007. Learned counsel for the petitioners contends that the case of the petitioner is covered as per the judgment dated 27.07.2017 passed in CWP10631-2017 titled as ‘Captain Kawar Pal Chauhan and another Vs. Union of India and others.’ Learned counsel for the respondents is not in a position to dispute that the controversy involved in the matter already stands decided in favour of the petitioners vide the above said judgment. The present writ petition is accordingly allowed in view of the order dated 27.07.2017 passed in CWP-10631-2017 titled as ‘Captain Kawar Pal Chauhan and another Vs. Union of India and others.’ (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ) FEBRUARY 17, 2025. JUDGE Rajender
